question: The blue green alga Anabaena lives in the leaves of Azolla, a freshwater fern, forming which of the following relationships?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Symbiotic**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Symbiotic** relationships are interactions between two different organisms living in close physical association, typically to the advantage of both.
 
• The blue-green alga **Anabaena** lives in the leaves of the freshwater fern **Azolla**, forming a mutualistic relationship.
 
• In this relationship, **Anabaena** provides nitrogen through nitrogen fixation, which benefits **Azolla**.
 
• **Azolla** provides a habitat and nutrients to **Anabaena**, enabling it to thrive.
 
• This type of relationship is crucial for ecosystems as it enhances the nitrogen content in water bodies, promoting plant growth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Symbiosis** can be of various types, such as mutualism, commensalism, and parasitism, depending on the nature of the interaction.
 
• The relationship between **Anabaena** and **Azolla** is a classic example of **mutualism**, a type of symbiosis where both partners benefit.
 
• **Anabaena** is known for its ability to fix atmospheric nitrogen, which is a critical nutrient for many plants.
 
• Such symbiotic relationships are also studied for their potential use in sustainable agriculture and water management practices.
 
• Understanding symbiotic relationships helps in the conservation of biodiversity and maintenance of healthy ecosystems.
